TaskDescription: Interictal HFO snippets: up to 500 detected HFOs on electrode elec91, all channels shown

Bandpass.Description: 80-500 Hz filtered (release README); RMS channels are the smoothed root-mean-square of the filtered signal

iEEGReference: Recording reference: lab standard placed between Fz and Cz (Lin et al. 2024, Data acquisition). Re-referencing of the released snippets is not stated.
Description: Converted from files/UMHS-0030-elec91.mat (MATLAB 7.3): data.filtdata / data.rmsdata cells (500 snippets x 1441 samples x 100 channels), concatenated in snippet order (events.tsv gives the boundaries). SamplingFrequency is the file's FS variable (3600 Hz); the recording rate in PatientInfo.fs is 4096 Hz. Values stored as IEEE float32 (source float64). Channel naming: E### = Electrodes.stdEEGChanIdx (channel labels not in the release); type MISC (grid/strip/depth not stated per channel). Amplitude units are not stated in the release (units n/a).
